identification: Pair of vintage bongo drums with green pearl/marble celluloid wrap, chrome hoops, tuning lugs and rims, natural skin heads. Typical of 1960s-70s Japanese-made bongos (Pearl and Star were the main Japanese makers, per Not So Modern Drummer). No maker label visible, so brand not confirmed. Single photo.

viewing_check: Estimate $30-40, current bid $25. Check the skins for splits, the rims and lugs for rust, and look inside the shells for a Pearl or other maker label. Similar vintage Japanese pearl-wrap bongos sell about A$70-95 on eBay (2024-2025, steady). With buyer's premium 22% the cost at the current bid is about $30.50 and they are bulky to post.
